Cosmos3-Edge (local) rows are included only if vlm_local_clean.jsonl exists; in the 2026-10-29 run the GPU was full and then the shared GPU lock was held by another exploration, so none exist.
Training-time success halves: A = seeds 100000-100024, B = 100025-100049 (held-out report).
